clue.text: About to analyse first something that's an astronomical length

indicators.note: first tells us the analysing word goes ahead of the abbreviation for about

parts.note: to analyse a sentence grammatically is to parse it
C, short for circa, means about

explanation.surface: Someone sets about analysing a vast distance in space before anything else.
explanation.definitionFit: A parsec is a unit of distance used by astronomers, about 3.26 light years.

parts.note: reads like lining up at a bus stop, but a queue is also an old word for a pigtail, so forming one means weaving hair

explanation.definitionFit: A queue in the old sense is a braid of hair hanging at the back, so making one is braiding.

definitions.meaning: a device that showers water over a lawn
the perforated nozzle on a watering can or hose

explanation.definitionFit: A garden watering device scatters water in drops; so does the perforated nozzle called a rose.

definitions.meaning: to have a flirtation or affair
to make a great fuss or rant at length

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb covers both conducting an affair and making a noisy fuss.

parts.note: an injured finger may be cut
a lass is a girl or young woman

explanation.surface: A glass ornament has hurt a nice girl.
explanation.definitionFit: Cut glass is decorative glassware with facets ground into it, often called crystal.

clue.text: Seaman who has demonstrated his all-round ability

definitions.text: Seaman who has demonstrated his all-round ability

parts.words: Seaman who has demonstrated his all-round ability
parts.note: all-round sounds like versatility, but literally means a sailor who has gone all the way round the globe

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who sails right around the world has literally proved he can go all the way round.

parts.note: uniformly seems to mean consistently, but points to a soldier in uniform, from the saying about swearing like one

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom 'swear like a trooper' makes a cavalry soldier the byword for foul language.

definitions.meaning: as when declining to cast a vote
to hold back from doing something

explanation.definitionFit: To decline voting is the electoral sense; holding back from an indulgence is the general one.

parts.note: calling suggests a vocation, but here it is what an actor is called, a professional alias

explanation.definitionFit: Performers often adopt a professional name for the theatre, which is literally what they are called there.

clue.text: One who loves to read or write again

indicators.note: writing the letters out again in a new order signals a rearrangement

explanation.surface: Someone devoted to books loves to read them or rewrite them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'write again' rearranges READ and OR into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A devotee or admirer is someone who loves another person or thing.

clue.text: Radio he's retuned in the old country

indicators.note: a radio retuned is set differently, so the letters are put in a different order

explanation.surface: A man retunes his radio to pick up a station back home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retuned' rearranges RADIO and HES; the country is the former name of Zimbabwe (and earlier Zambia too).
explanation.definitionFit: Rhodesia was the colonial name of a southern African state, now Zimbabwe, so it is a country that no longer exists under that name.

clue.text: One is grateful to say this

definitions.text: One is grateful to say this

parts.words: One is grateful to say this
parts.note: reads like a relieved remark, but simply describes the phrase uttered by someone who feels gratitude

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is the standard expression of gratitude.

parts.note: PI, short for pious, is crossword shorthand for good
a rate is a price or value set on something

explanation.surface: A sea robber has brought something valuable aboard.
explanation.definitionFit: A corsair was a privateer or sea raider, especially on the Barbary coast.

indicators.note: badly signals the letters of the two words are jumbled

explanation.surface: Nine people have bled heavily, so blankets are needed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' rearranges NINE and BLED; 'needed' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Sheets and pillowcases are the coverings put on a bed.

clue.text: Sort of liar who needs no unmasking?

definitions.text: Sort of liar who needs no unmasking?

parts.words: Sort of liar who needs no unmasking?
parts.note: a liar of this kind already shows his face uncovered, so there is no mask to remove

explanation.definitionFit: A shameless liar lies openly, literally with his face bare.

indicators.note: the lady trails, that is follows behind, the head letter

parts.note: the head of red is its first letter
Wanda is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A woman was following a ginger-haired person.
explanation.definitionFit: Rwanda is a nation in central Africa.

parts.note: an arrow is a weapon shot from a bow
a root is the base or source of something

explanation.surface: A weapon is planted at the foot of something.
explanation.definitionFit: Arrowroot is a tropical plant whose tuber yields a starch.

definitions.meaning: a stern, rigid enforcer of rules
a rod for packing the charge into a muzzle-loading gun

explanation.definitionFit: A rod for loading a gun gives its name to an unbending person who enforces strict order.

clue.text: Ronald in charge after short time, how foolish

indicators.note: after means the name and abbreviation follow the short time

parts.note: MO, short for moment, is a short time
Ron is a short form of Ronald

explanation.surface: Ronald has only just taken charge and already done something stupid.
explanation.definitionFit: Moronic means extremely stupid, so the exclamation 'how foolish' fits as a descriptive phrase.

clue.text: One who gets a kick from rejecting society?

definitions.text: One who gets a kick from rejecting society?

parts.words: One who gets a kick from rejecting society?
parts.note: gets a kick suggests thrills, but here hints at being kicked out, a person who leaves conventional life

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who abandons conventional society or education is called this.

parts.note: living is a church benefice held by a parish priest, so these are the quarters that go with it

explanation.definitionFit: The house provided for the clergyman of a parish comes with his benefice, or living.

clue.text: Bird put some chocolate on the lever

parts.note: a crow is a black bird
chocolate is sold in bars

explanation.surface: A bird sets a chocolate bar on top of a lever.
explanation.definitionFit: A crowbar is an iron bar used as a lever to prise things open.

clue.text: Give up on account of oneself?

parts.note: for can mean because of
the ego is one's self

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether to quit for selfish reasons.
explanation.definitionFit: To forgo is to do without, a spelling variant also written with an E.

clue.text: Race-goers shouldn't get a bad deal here

definitions.text: Race-goers shouldn't get a bad deal here

parts.words: Race-goers shouldn't get a bad deal here
parts.note: deal is also a kind of timber, so a place whose name promises sound timber should not offer a poor one

explanation.walkthrough: The answer is a racecourse in Sussex, England.
explanation.definitionFit: Goodwood is a famous English racecourse whose name splits into words for quality timber, and deal is pine timber.

definitions.meaning: ... play breaks the spirit of the game

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses share the word: unfair play is called dirty, and so is something soiled.

clue.text: Come face to face to study battleline

parts.note: to con is an old word for to study or learn
the front is where opposing armies meet

explanation.surface: A general prepares to meet the enemy by studying the line of battle.
explanation.definitionFit: To confront is to meet someone or something head-on.

definitions.meaning: British slang calls the phone the ...

explanation.surface: A caller is panting down the phone.
explanation.definitionFit: One who puffs hard blows air; British slang also uses the word for the telephone.

clue.text: Animal cannot be found inside bottle

indicators.note: the contraction is to be placed inside the animal

parts.note: a deer is an animal
can't is the contraction of cannot

explanation.surface: An animal is nowhere to be found inside a bottle.
explanation.definitionFit: A decanter is a stoppered glass vessel into which wine is poured.

clue.text: Please do not start to endorse

indicators.note: the word for please loses its opening letter

parts.note: to gratify is to please

explanation.surface: Please don't begin approving things yet.
explanation.definitionFit: To ratify is to approve formally, confirming an agreement.
